lines.en: I make my way down the hall after spending a short while in my office with Makoto, trying to figure out a little more information about why it’s suddenly okay for me to teach more students.
The rich girl, Touka, makes sense considering that I somehow managed to leave a good impression on her mother by...
Audibly having sex with a [teenage]girl in the room next door to her all night?
You’d think something like that would raise a red flag, but apparently not.
Oh well. They’re probably just a weird family.
The second girl, on the other hand, is the one we still can’t figure anything out for.
Her previous teachers wouldn’t even speak with me, which makes me worry that it’s going to be another Yumi-type situation.
But hey, if it is, I guess that will keep one more desk free most days. So I’m fine with it in that regard.
: No way! Already?! That’s so awesome!
: Hahah, yeah...I’m a little surprised too.
I hear two familiar voices crawling out from around the corner and decide to get myself involved in time that I’m sure both of them would rather spend alone.
Or at least time one of them would rather spend alone. The other one, I’m not so sure of yet.
: Oh, hey! Are you done with your office hours already?
: Yo. Welcome to...what is apparently our new hang out spot.
: Hey. It’s looking pretty lively over here today.
: Otoha’s parents just approved her staying in the dorms, so we’re having a sort of...impromptu celebration.
: In the hallway? Shouldn’t you be out at like, a restaurant or something? Or even the cafe?
: Oh dear. We’re not getting in trouble for loitering, are we?
: No way. Sensei’s only ever given detention to Yumi and that’s just cause she’s a bitch.
: Yumi? Is there someone in our class with that name?
: Barely. She just shows up every once in a while to say mean things to Futaba and then leave.
: Why would anyone ever say anything mean to Futaba? She’s like, the nicest girl I’ve ever met.
: Where is this Yumi character, by the way? I’m very eager to meet her and knock her off her high horse.
: Probably wandering around the city somewhere.
: I don’t know if I’d call her horse high, though. She has some stuff she’s dealing with as well.
: And that excuses her for all of the horrible things she’s said to my best friend?
: Nodoka...you don’t have to do anything. I’m fine.
: Of course it doesn’t excuse her. But I’d feel a little bad if someone were to bully her as well after hearing some of what she’s been through.
: Wait, did you actually learn something about Yumi, Sensei?
: Has anyone other than like...Chika ever done that before?
: Waaaaait...I knew that girl was familiar.
: Chika’s the one you have a crush on, right? She’s the reason you didn’t want to meet at the mall that one time.
: That’s-
: Uhhhhhh...
: Dude, it’s fine. Tell me more about her.
: Uhh...I don’t really know if...that’s something I want to talk about right now...
: Regardless of exactly what you found out about this girl, I don’t intend to just let her walk all over my friend.
: Is she okay, Sensei?
: Who, Yumi?
: Yeah. She’s Yumi. She’ll be fine.
: I’m kind of interested in hearing what Nodoka plans to do to her, though.
: I have to say, I’m pretty sure a fight wouldn’t exactly go in your favor.
: I don’t intend to fight her. I just want to have a little talk with her and inform her of exactly how amazing this girl is.
: Thank you, but...I’m nowhere near amazing.
: There’s still plenty of stuff I have to work on...
: Oh? Anything I can help with?
: Not unless you want to start going to the gym.
: Oof.
: Sure. Why not?
: I know you’re aware of how much I hate physical activity but, if it’s for you, I’ll do my best.
: Oh! Gym talk! I’m part of this!
: Are we finally going to start working out?
: If that’s okay with you...I think I’d like to.
: There’s only so long until the beach trip and...even if it’s the winter and there won't be any bathing suits, I’d like to look a little...slimmer.
: You look great, Futaba. But if that’s what will make you happy, I’ll come too.
: We can all go as a group. It’ll be fun.
: Will you be joining us as well, Sensei?
: Wait! I’ll be...a lot less comfortable if he comes! And...the dorm gym can only fit...four people so...
: What kind of gym only fits four people?
: None, clearly. Futaba is just afraid of causing you to get aroused by the swaying of her voluptuous breasts as she rides the elliptical.
: Hot.
: Sensei, do you think you’d be able to keep your eyes off of Futaba as her boobs go crazy and stuff?
: Ugh...
: First off, no.
: Second, I don’t really want to go to the gym.
: But you’ll get to see all of us in form fitting clothes and leggings and stuff.
: Okay, maybe I want to go to the gym.
: There’s the Sensei I know.
: Thinking with his penis instead of his heart like the true asshole he is.
: You know, the more I think about it, the more I realize that Rin might actually be the weird one and you might be totally normal, Sensei.
: I can assure you that we’re both equally weird.
: I haven’t known him for very long, but I think I would give the edge to Sensei in a “weirdness” contest.
: Especially after what happened between us in the janitor’s closet during lunch today.
: J-Janitor’s closet?!
: Yes. Nodoka is extremely good with her hands.
: Those were actually my feet. That’s just how good I am.
: Uhhh...
: Sensei! She literally just transferred in!
: The body wants what the body wants.
: Okay, before this goes any further and anyone believes us, I want to confirm that there was no janitor’s closet.
: Oh, that’s right. I spent lunch on the rooftop today. I completely mixed those two things up.
: You two are...quite interesting together.
: He’s like the tall, handsome father I never had.
: But if I’m your father, then why would we spend lunch in the-
: Oh, right.
: Awwwww, you remembered my [incest] kink. That’s so sweet.
: This story got a lot less exciting as soon as I realized it didn’t actually happen.
: Ooooookay, I’m gonna go out on a limb here and change the topic since I don’t really want to talk about [incest] with my teacher.
: Or...anyone, really.
: Don’t listen to Otoha. She secretly pines for a little brother to fully devote herself to.
: Where would you even come up with an idea like that?!
: The same place I came up with this idea-
: No! I’m supposed to change the topic! You’re just going to pick something weird again!
: Not at all. I’m just going to invite Sensei to the grand opening of our shared bedroom.
: And I am going to happily accept.
: See?! Weird!
: It’s okay, Otoha. If you close your eyes, it’s like he’s not even there.
: He would still totally be there, though!
: Do you not want me in your room, Otoha?
: I’m more confused about why you’d want to come over in the first place.
: Like, don’t you have a girlfriend or something?
: Sensei isn’t allowed to have a girlfriend because his [niece] would get really mad and cut his penis off.
: Oooooh?
: It’s not what you’re thinking, Nodoka...
Just kidding. It totally is.
I obviously can’t let anyone know that, though.
: I feel...very relieved to hear that for some reason.
: Not the p-penis thing...but...the girlfriend thing...
: Good. And to answer your question, Otoha...no.
: But it’s not because I’m not allowed to have one.
: It’s because you like [teenager]s.
: No. Well, yes. But that’s not why either.
: I just don’t want one.
: I’m not really relationship material.
: I...don’t think that’s true, Sensei...
: I think you would be really good at it if you wanted to be...
: See, that’s the thing. I don’t want to be.
: I mean, I guess it doesn’t really matter either way.
: It’s not like you’d have a hard time getting one or anything. You’re a pretty attractive guy.
: You should see him in a dimly lit janitor’s closet. That’s where he really shines.
: I’m just...going to keep assuming that everything Nodoka says is a joke...
: That is probably for the best.
: On a completely serious note, I do think you should stop by soon.
: The four of us will be having a little move-in party, and it would be nice to have someone to move all of our belongings into the room while we drink tea and listen to sad music.
: You know, for a second, I thought I was actually being invited to party.
: You are. Just as a mover and not a partygoer.
: I’ll save you some tea, though.
: You can chill too, if you want. I don’t mind helping you move everything.
: I’ve got a lot of heavier stuff so I’d feel really bad if you were just handling all of it on your own.
: Thank you, Otoha. Finally, someone who sees me as a human being and not a piece of meat.
: I don’t think you’re just meat!
: In fact, I’ve never thought that even once!
: Boy am I glad I was only vegetarian for a few months.
: What’s wrong with being meat? Everybody likes meat.
: Not Noriko. She’s still going strong on her diet from what I hear.
: I can assure you that if I were meat, Noriko would break her diet immediately.
: Hey, yeah! We haven’t talked about that yet!
: Have you really known her for that long, Sensei?
: I’m...a little more confused about how Maya reacted.
: I could have sworn the two of you didn’t like each other very much.
: Ready to sit around and pretend we understand what’s going on, Nodoka?
: It smells like drama, Otoha.
: Quick, let’s use this opportunity to grab our notebooks and jot down ideas for our next poems.
: Don’t worry about how Maya reacted and don’t worry about how long I’ve known Noriko for.
: Neither of those things really concern either of you.
: Sure they do! You’re a big part of our lives, Sensei. Do you have any idea how often we talk about you?
: Like, at least twice a week.
: The way you started that made it sound like it was going to be a lot more...
: I said “at least!” Sometimes it is more.
: I suppose I can look past Maya’s reaction since...it’s the only time I’ve ever seen her do anything like that...
: It...did stick out, though.
: So...I wouldn’t be surprised if someone else made a bigger deal out of it.
: I feel like we missed something really juicy.
: But I guess if anyone could make things juicy, it's Noriko.
: She carries this knife thing around and, this one time, she sliced her leg open so bad that there was blood literally everywhere.
: She didn’t even think it was a big deal, though, and just kinda laughed it off. Girl is crazy.
: Good crazy, though. She’s fun.
: Yeah, nothing says fun like...blood everywhere.
: Point is, Sensei, you know you can talk to us if you ever need an extra set of ears.
: And we’ve got like, eight whole ears at the end of this hallway for you right now.
: It does seem slightly unfair that you’re the sole individual designated to counseling all of us.
: Yeah, so I guess I’d be down to listen too if you want to open up to somebody you just met and have talked to like, less than five times.
: Is this an intervention or something? Why did everyone suddenly start offering me help?
: Just seems like things are gettin’ a little crazy for you. It would do you some good to take a load off in Otoha and Nodoka’s room sometime.
: Rin...you probably shouldn’t invite someone to someone else’s room...
: Didn’t we already decide it was okay, though?
: Still...it’s the...principle of actually doing that.
: Screw it, yeah. Come chill with us.
: If you think it’s fun hanging out and listening to music with a bunch of [teenage]girls, be our guest.
: Literally. Become our guest.
: Simply arriving will net you a total of twenty more Nodoka points.
: Nodoka points? What’s a Nodoka point?
: How many do I have and what can I do with them?
: It’s a currency I created up specifically for Sensei.
: I use them to determine how far along in our relationship we are.
: That...kind of makes it sound like you have...ulterior motives.
: Not at all. Everyone has a secret currency for everyone else whether they’re aware of it or not.
: I’m sure that all of you have been slowly building up points with him in your heads as you experience new things together.
: I was just smart enough to assign a separate numeric value to mine so I can keep better track of them.
: You’re making this impromptu point system sound a lot more logical than I’m sure it actually is.
: We’ll see if you’ll still be saying that when you go to cash them in some day.
: Welp, I’m lost. But if you want your Nodoka points or whatever, feel free to drop by.
: I’m probably going to be spending my free time during the weekends just...scoping out new parks to play in or something if you ever want to come hang out for some reason.
: And I’ll be somewhere with many books. Doing book things.
: Aren’t you supposed to be a writer? Where’s your clever word usage?
: Book thingies. Come to the reading place to say hi to the Nodoka.
: So the library. Got it.
: You’re fucking weird.
: You love me already. I can feel it.
I decide to let the four girls carry on the rest of their conversation without adult supervision and begin my journey away from the[school].
I’m not sure how I’m going to spend the rest of my night, but at least now I know that there is one more dorm room ready and willing to accept me with open arms.
Not like it would matter even if they weren’t.
I’m sure I’d find a way in regardless because...
Well, that’s just the type of person I am.
And having two more people who either accept that or simply don’t understand it yet-
It’s a welcome change.
Even if it’s a change I’ve been feeling time and time again lately.
Life sure is getting exciting, isn’t it?
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
Congratulations! You can now spend time with Nodoka and Otoha outside of[school]!
